title: Phase 1: JSON format spike (authority vs oracle)
description:
## Why
ZSDL is a compact oracle DSL, not a reviewable authority document. Zero-arg wrappers made the implementation export the test.

## Done when
One gold package (JSON) has: Markdown characterization, compiled public-API oracle calling dumps/loads with arguments, held-out vectors the synthesizer never sees, no zero-arg wrappers. Layer 2 json.zspec.zsdl can be the public oracle.
acceptance_criteria: JSON package.md (or equivalent) + public-API oracle + held-out file + cleanroom_json graded on dumps/loads, not json_loads_int.
close_reason: JSON gold-set spike shipped: gold/json/package.md, dumps/loads public oracle, held-out outside zspecs/, held_out_guard. theseus_json 22/22 + 14/14 held-out. Not qualified.

title: Withdraw qualification claims from registry and docs
description:
## Why
README, AGENTS.md, architecture.md, and theseus_registry.json currently advertise hundreds of verified replacements.

## Done when
Registry carries a ladder block with qualification_claim=withdrawn; user-facing docs stop claiming qualified replacements; a withdrawn-verified list is generated.

title: Publish ADR 0001 verification ladder
description:
## Why
status=verified currently means isolation plus N listed invariants. That is not qualification.

## Done when
docs/decisions/0001-verification-ladder.md defines inventoried through qualified, withdraws qualification claims, and points at the autopsy.

title: Write reproducible corpus autopsy classifier
description:
## Why
Classification must be regenerable from zspecs/ and theseus_registry.json, not a one-off spreadsheet.

## Done when
tools/corpus_autopsy.py classifies oracle quality, contract shape, feasibility, and duplicate families; tests cover fixtures; make corpus-autopsy writes reports/audit/.
close_reason: Classifier, tests, make corpus-autopsy, and committed autopsy reports.

title: Phase 0: corpus autopsy and verification ladder
description:
## Why
Theseus scaled a toy isolation gate into hundreds of 'verified' clean-room packages. The refresh starts by classifying the corpus and replacing that boolean with a verification ladder.

## Done when
Autopsy of every ZSDL spec and registry package is committed, ADR 0001 defines the ladder and withdraws qualification claims, follow-up issues exist for Phases 1-4, and no new packages were added.
acceptance_criteria: Autopsy JSON/MD committed; ADR 0001 committed; registry ladder.qualification_claim=withdrawn; README/AGENTS no longer claim 392 qualified replacements.
close_reason: Phase 0 complete: autopsy, ADR 0001, qualification withdrawn, follow-ups filed.

title: Phase 4: keep or drop replacement as a product claim
description:
## Why
Phase 3 is the kill gate. The project must choose characterization-only vs slow gold-set growth.

## Done when
An accepted decision updates README/AGENTS product claims. Either (a) grow qualified packages slowly via capabilities and sealed artifacts, or (b) Theseus is a characterization/oracle corpus and says so.
acceptance_criteria: ADR or PLAN update reflecting Phase 3 outcomes; README matches the decision.

title: Phase 3: gold-set regenerative qualification
description:
## Why
Theseus never ran empty-workspace regeneration against a held-out oracle. That is the existence proof for replacement.

## Done when
5-10 high-feasibility packages (json, base64, hashlib, uuid, semver, tomli, struct, binascii, urllib_parse, difflib, libpcap/pcapng, fnmatch, shlex, hmac) attempt qualification: empty workspace, hidden oracle, isolation, twice. Results published without inflating package count.
acceptance_criteria: Qualification records for the attempted set; fewer than half passing means replacement is not the product claim.

title: Phase 2: characterization loop with uncertainty review
description:
## Why
Modern LLMs improve characterization only if drafts are reviewed, uncertainty is explicit, and Layer 2 oracles are deepened against the installed original.

## Done when
A characterization loop exists (docs + live probes, not implementation source in the generator). The intended gold-set Layer 2 specs are re-oracled to RFC/KAT completeness where applicable.
acceptance_criteria: Documented loop; gold-set Layer 2 specs deepened; uncertainty ledger for drafts.
close_reason: Characterization loop shipped: ADR 0003, docs/characterization-loop.md, tools/live_probe.py + characterize.py, gold/<family> authority+ledgers, gold-set Layer 2 RFC/KAT deepen. Not qualified.

title: File Phase 1-4 follow-up issues
description:
## Why
Phase 0 is an autopsy. Format spike, characterization loop, gold-set qualification, and the decision gate need tracked work.

## Done when
Beads issues exist for Phases 1-4, blocked on Phase 0 completion.

value: Phase 1 JSON spike (ADR 0002) is done. theseus_json is cleanroom_public_api/deep but still legacy_isolation. Held-out lives in gold/json/held_out.zspec.zsdl. Next is Phase 2 theseus-il4.

Theseus status=verified is legacy isolation only (ADR 0001). Qualification is withdrawn; 0 packages qualified. Next work is Phase 1 JSON format spike (theseus-bi7): Markdown authority, public-API oracle, held-out vectors, no zero-arg wrappers.
